name: Notification System Dispatch
description: Outbound-delivery framework for notification_system: a notification_system_dispatcher channel plugin type, a queue + queue worker, an event subscriber that reacts to new notifications, per-user channel/group preferences and send-mode (immediate/daily/weekly) bundling via a notification_dispatch_bundle entity, plus a user-settings block and form.
project_description: The dispatch submodule of notification_system sends gathered notifications out of Drupal. It defines a notification_system_dispatcher plugin type (a delivery channel), and ships an event subscriber that reacts to the framework's NewNotificationEvent by either queueing the notification for immediate delivery or accumulating it into a per-user notification_dispatch_bundle for a daily or weekly summary. A queue worker instantiates the target dispatcher and calls dispatch() during cron. Each user can enable or disable individual channels and per-group delivery through a UserSettingsService (stored in user.data) surfaced by a user-settings form and block. Site settings choose default channels, a send mode, bundling, an optional whitelist (for testing) and a forced dispatcher for critical notifications. Concrete channels are provided by notification_system_dispatch_mail and notification_system_dispatch_webpush.
